content: Hillingdon Hospital is a National Health Service (NHS) hospital situated on Pield Heath Road in Uxbridge, Greater London. It functions as a general hospital, catering to the healthcare needs of the local community. The hospital offers a comprehensive range of medical services, including an Accident and Emergency (A&E) department that manages approximately 64,000 patients annually, inpatient care, day surgery, and outpatient clinics. Hillingdon Hospital is one of only two hospitals operated by the Hillingdon Hospital NHS Trust. The hospital is committed to delivering high-quality emergency and specialist care that is patient-centered, accessible, and responsive to the needs of the community. The local population served by the hospital is diverse, encompassing a wide range of ethnic backgrounds and religious beliefs. The hospital ensures that cultural and religious sensitivities are respected, such as accommodating the preferences of Muslim patients who may request not to be treated by healthcare professionals of a specific gender. Additionally, the hospital is equipped with a single helipad located on its roof, which facilitates the landing of air ambulances and private helicopters for emergency and specialized transport needs.
